text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a66

g.text: Each panel has its own yardstick. Panel 2 counts the lives that ended during training, panel 3 the test lives, so their numbers differ. A seed is one training run from its own random start.
